# Where seeking rests: more than now never does, above all others never for two

> Under a determined law, seeking rests exactly at a state the law leaves unchanged that meets its target: more than now needs an open world, and above all others never holds of two; where what stands is listed, rising without end needs steps that do not run down, and running down stops it.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Under a determined law next, the orbit from s comes to rest with its target met from some step on exactly when it reaches a state next leaves unchanged that meets the target (Law.rests_iff); a target met at such a state is met at every later step (Law.fixed_rests). More than now, a quantity q of one's own rising across the step (MoreThanNow), is met only by change (more_not_at_rest, Law.more_never_rests); met at every step, q rises between any two later steps (more_rises), so every configuration is new (more_new) and no list holds them (more_needs_open, an instance of unlisted_of_new); counting on meets it (succ_more). Above all others, every other seeker's quantity below one's own (AboveAll), is met at a state by at most one seeker (aboveAll_unique, aboveAll_not_two), so under any law no state left unchanged meets it for two seekers (Law.aboveAll_never_rests). Where what stands is listed at each step (Web.StandingCensus), a condition rising at arbitrarily late steps needs, at arbitrarily late steps, steps across which what stands does not run down (Flow.more_needs_unrun, from Flow.change_recurs_iff); where what stands runs down at every step from some step on, no condition rises at arbitrarily late steps (Flow.more_exhausted). No Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Seeking.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Seeking.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- A target is any condition on the configuration; how a target forms is not modelled. rests_iff assumes a determined law; B2 assumes what stands is listed at each step, a local condition written into the theorems.
- Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number quantities.

Ren on 10 October: “the seeking system got locked in, what they are pursuing is illusion(in south asia and Buddhism)” and “find the boundary condition for 无明”; on 11 October: “yes let's do 无明”. B1 (enough) and B2 (expansion or exhaustion) of the 无明 boundary plan are stated here; B3 (feedback) and B4 (明) are the theorems of P49, P53 and P55 read for seeking, not restated; B5 (hijacking) is not stated. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): 无明 is the not-seeing that keeps seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest, and its boundary is B1; 明 is registration reaching what support does not mark; 知足 and 知止 are targets within the boundary; dominance as such is not the target ruled out. See §83 of the integration note.

## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 13 theorems of Becoming.Seeking all have empty axiom reports, among them Law.rests_iff, more_needs_open, aboveAll_unique, Flow.more_needs_unrun and Flow.more_exhausted; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §83 of the integration note; not independently reviewed, whether it needs a review is Ren's call.

How a target forms or is revised, that a seeker pursues it, and which targets actual formations hold are not derived; hijacking (B5) is stated separately, in target-capture; rests_iff is for determined laws only; B2 says only that the rises stop recurring, not that exhaustion ends the seekers themselves; the counting of B1 is elementary, and the substance is in stating it of targets within the unfolding; the readings are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; contains no ethical predicate.

- Boundary: more than now can be met at every step, but only by change and only in an open world: counting on (`succ_more`) meets it at every step and never rests (`Law.more_never_rests`), and no list holds the configurations it passes through (`more_needs_open`). [Seeking.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Seeking.lean)
- Boundary: above all others is met by at most one seeker at a state (`aboveAll_unique`, `aboveAll_not_two`), so for a family holding two seekers no state the law leaves unchanged meets it for both (`Law.aboveAll_never_rests`). [Seeking.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Seeking.lean)
